title: ATLAS Master Program and FawxzzyPlatform Wave 0
register_scope: Deterministic authority index and admission map. It does not replace lane, marker, owner, board, deployment, runtime, or receipt truth.

authority_model.rule: Index existing authority by reference; never copy a mutable status into a competing source of truth.
evidence_order: current Git and exact owner-repository evidence
current runtime, deployment, database, and board readback
current tests, CI, and validation evidence
current owner receipts and accepted manifests
authority_model.unknown_rule: Unavailable or denied evidence remains UNKNOWN, never zero or healthy.
authority_model.owner_lane_rule: Fitness, Mazer, Socials OS, and FawxzzyWeb remain independent standing owner lanes.
authority_model.single_writer_rule: At most one ATLAS root writer, one owner-repository writer, and one logical DiscordOS board writer.

measurement_policy.percentage_rule: New work remains percentage null until a deterministic measurement contract is accepted.
measurement_policy.decomposition_rule: Rows, epics, phases, packets, and the master-program row count are decomposition only and never become a denominator by inference.

approval_gate_catalog.requirement: Current exact approval before creating or upgrading any paid project.
Current exact approval before production Auth or OAuth change.
Current exact approval before production data cutover.
Current exact approval before entering maintenance or user-visible write restriction.
Current exact approval before a breaking secret rotation.
Current exact approval before destructive schema or data contraction.
Current exact approval before disabling or deleting a source project or service.
Current exact approval before physically merging DiscordOS into the public platform project.
Current exact approval before any other irreversible action.
Current project-specific approval for each Vercel production deploy, promotion, rollback, or alias cutover.

global_holds.rule: Platform repository creation, schema/Auth/billing migration, and rehearsal remain held until FP-DOS-REC-001, FP-MZR-REC-001, FP-FIT-REC-001, and a fresh FP-PARITY-RATCHET-001 close serially.
The mandatory exhaustive closing audit and completion of every newly discovered preparatory marker precede post-preparation development.
Wave 0 is root-governance and admission only: no owner repository, Supabase, Vercel, Discord, social account, production, secret, or canonical ATLAS checkout mutation.

programs.title: Clean and Re-sync authority index
programs.authority: docs/registry/ATLAS-FULL-SYSTEM-REEVALUATION-LANES.json plus accepted marker and receipt sources
programs.scope: Index every current lane and backlog entry without repeating its status, percentage, denominator, timestamp, or evidence body.
serialization: Canonical lane and marker producers write first; this generated register indexes their IDs.
definition_of_done: Every lane and backlog ID is present in the generated authority index.
No historical value is normalized or rewritten.
programs.next_packet: Resolve the next packet from the canonical lane selector and accepted receipts.

programs.title: Mandatory closing exhaustive audit
programs.authority: docs/memory/initiatives/continuity-manifest-atlas-full-system-re-evaluation.json
programs.scope: Run the accepted second exhaustive gate only after operational preparation and all discovered preparatory markers are terminal.
serialization: Do not rerun the accepted opening audit.
Development discoveries are queued; preparatory gaps receive their own markers.
definition_of_done: One separately accepted exhaustive closing audit closes gate 2 of 2.
Every preparatory gap found by it is complete before development opens.
programs.next_packet: Resolve current closing-audit status and routing from the canonical continuity manifest and marker authority.

programs.title: DiscordOS board consistency and maintenance
programs.authority: DiscordOS contracts, exact journals/readback, owner export, and accepted board receipts
programs.scope: Maintain canonical profiles, tags, permissions, board #14 FawxzzyWeb, exact journal/readback semantics, current-state consistency, and one logical writer.
serialization: Identity reconciliation precedes event replay.
Board writes are idempotent and exact-thread scoped.
definition_of_done: Current cards and journals reconcile exactly with zero duplicate stable IDs.
Historical records remain distinct from active state.
programs.next_packet: Use the currently admitted DiscordOS board cluster before FP-DOS-REC-001.

programs.title: GitHub control-plane watch and hygiene
programs.authority: docs/registry/GITHUB-CONTROL-PLANE-REGISTRY.json and fresh exact-head GitHub evidence
programs.scope: Track CI, PRs, branches, security, remote/local parity, releases, and local-first cloud-backup hygiene while preserving unavailable endpoints as UNKNOWN.
serialization: Read-only collection precedes cleanup or policy mutation.
Exact-head CI and review precede merge authority.
definition_of_done: Every governed repository has fresh parity and control-plane evidence.
Denied security surfaces remain UNKNOWN.
programs.next_packet: Continue the existing GitHub control-plane watch cadence.

programs.title: FawxzzyWeb distribution and canonical-origin migration
programs.authority: FawxzzyWeb owner repository, owner export, Discord admission, and current deployment/link readback
programs.scope: Govern canonical origin, link migration, public distribution, owner export, and Discord admission without absorbing product implementation into root.
serialization: Owner export precedes root projection.
Preview and rendered-link proof precede production cutover.
definition_of_done: Canonical origin and every migrated link are route-proven.
Owner export and Discord admission reconcile without duplicate authority.
programs.next_packet: Resolve from the FawxzzyWeb owner lane after its current board cluster.

programs.title: FawxzzyPlatform migration
programs.owner: ATLAS coordinator plus serialized Fitness, Mazer, DiscordOS, Foundation, Lifeline, _stack, and application owners
programs.authority: docs/registry/FAWXZZY-PLATFORM-MIGRATION-ADMISSION.json
programs.scope: Recover source truth, prove backup/restore and ledger parity, seed the platform from Fitness, rehearse identity/data/RLS/billing/cross-service auth, use previews, perform separately approved cutovers, observe and roll back or quarantine, and separately approve retirement or deletion.
serialization: One canonical ledger.
Expand -> migrate -> verify -> cutover -> contract.
DiscordOS remains physically separate by default.
definition_of_done: Parity, backup/restore, rehearsal, migration, cutover, observation, rollback, quarantine, and retirement gates have current accepted evidence.
No source is disabled or deleted without separate exact approval.
programs.next_packet: FP-DOS-REC-001

programs.title: Atlas Book and Playbook exhaustive text convergence
programs.authority: initiative-fawxzzy-tech-plan-convergence plus Playbook-owned doctrine and corpus sources
programs.scope: Inventory and classify all text-bearing artifacts, prioritize Playbook historical planning and research, audit corpus coverage, and later decide the Book/Playbook boundary through an ADR.
dependencies: accepted Book/Playbook ADR before authority transfer
serialization: Playbook archaeology precedes consolidation recommendations.
Source reference and digest precede derived summaries.
definition_of_done: Every admitted corpus surface has provenance and coverage classification.
The later ADR and reversible migration plan resolve Book/Playbook ownership.
programs.next_packet: Whole-stack text inventory and Playbook-first corpus coverage contract.

programs.title: Long-task continuity and workstation hygiene
programs.authority: continuity, runtime-placement, worktree, and workstation-resource contracts
programs.scope: Prove context compaction, export, successor, archive, and recovery; classify idle processes, worktrees, browsers, servers, and CPU/GPU/RAM use without destructive cleanup by inference.
serialization: Export and successor proof precede archive.
Observe and classify resources before stop or delete authority.
definition_of_done: Long tasks can compact and resume without authority or evidence loss.
Idle-resource residue has explicit retention and stop policy.
programs.next_packet: Resolve from durable memory fabric and workspace-hygiene lanes.

programs.title: Post-preparation Atlas development
programs.authority: docs/memory/initiatives/initiative-atlas-post-preparation-development.json
programs.scope: After the closing gate, complete Lifeline, Foundation, Cortex, _stack, DiscordOS, Playbook, Atlas wiring, Atlas Book, and governed integrations.
serialization: Owner-specific contracts and proofs precede root ratchets.
Reversible integration waves precede replacement or retirement.
definition_of_done: Every named component has an accepted owner-specific completion contract and proof.
Cross-system wiring is observable, reversible, and receipt-backed.
programs.next_packet: Mandatory closing exhaustive audit, then measured component admissions.

programs.title: ChatGPT and Codex to Cortex conversion
programs.authority: Cortex readiness, contracts, simulations, and operator acceptance evidence
programs.scope: Convert the maximum feasible ChatGPT and Codex capability into Cortex only where capability, parity, safety, observability, cost, fallback, and rollback evidence justify it.
serialization: Codex-style structured coding workflows precede broader reasoning replacement.
No external dependency is removed before accepted parity and rollback proof.
definition_of_done: Each converted capability has accepted baseline, parity, fallback, and rollback evidence.
Unproven capabilities remain governed adapters.
programs.next_packet: Resolve from current Cortex readiness and accepted simulation evidence.

programs.title: Vercel and Supabase to Lifeline and Foundation conversion
programs.authority: runtime-placement, observability, backup/restore, deployment, and owner evidence
programs.scope: Convert the maximum feasible Vercel and Supabase capability only where hosting, data, security, identity, observability, cost, fallback, migration, and rollback proof justify it.
serialization: Read-only inventory and rehearsal precede cutover.
Native services remain until replacement proof and separately approved retirement.
definition_of_done: Every converted capability has parity, health, backup, rollback, and acceptance evidence.
Unconverted capability remains explicitly owned by its external adapter.
programs.next_packet: Read-only capability and evidence inventory after preparation gates.

programs.title: Fitness standing owner lane
programs.authority: Fitness owner repository, task, CI, runtime, Supabase, and accepted receipts
programs.scope: Preserve Fitness as an independent product lane and platform-seed owner; root indexes only shared contracts and parity dependencies.
serialization: Fitness writer owns Fitness changes.
Platform parity recovery precedes platform rehearsal.
definition_of_done: Fitness owner truth remains current and isolated.
Shared improvements promote through explicit contracts.
programs.next_packet: FP-FIT-REC-001 after earlier serialized recovery packets.

programs.title: Mazer standing owner lane
programs.authority: Mazer owner repository, standing task, CI, runtime, Supabase, and accepted receipts
programs.scope: Preserve Mazer product independence while governing platform identity/data migration and separately approval-gated retirement or deletion.
serialization: Mazer writer owns Mazer changes.
Exact replay/parity precedes source-only alias normalization.
definition_of_done: Mazer owner truth remains current and isolated.
Retirement and deletion remain separately approved after migration proof.
programs.next_packet: FP-MZR-REC-001 after FP-DOS-REC-001.

programs.title: Socials OS standing owner lane
programs.authority: Socials OS owner repository, standing task, account readback, and accepted receipts
programs.scope: Preserve Socials OS as independent and non-root-blocking; platform work may define scoped identity or integration contracts but cannot mutate social accounts.
serialization: Owner data collection and implementation remain in Socials OS.
Root consumes only accepted receipts and shared contracts.
definition_of_done: Owner truth remains isolated and receipt-backed.
No social-account mutation is inferred from root governance.
programs.next_packet: Resolve from the Socials OS standing owner task.

programs.title: FawxzzyWeb standing owner lane
programs.authority: FawxzzyWeb owner repository, deployment, owner export, and rendered-route evidence
programs.scope: Keep the canonical public website and former Trove /apps catalog owner-specific while exposing shared identity, entitlement, and distribution contracts.
serialization: Owner implementation precedes root projection.
Preview proof precedes production approval.
definition_of_done: Canonical-origin and integration behavior are owner-proven.
Root does not become the web implementation owner.
programs.next_packet: Resolve from the FawxzzyWeb owner lane and board #14.

programs.title: Shared contracts and Atlas wiring
programs.authority: versioned Atlas contracts, runtime placement, producer/consumer proof, and owner manifests
programs.scope: Maintain reusable shared contracts and observable wiring without collapsing component ownership or treating schema existence as adoption.
serialization: Contract proposal precedes implementation.
Owner adoption precedes root ratchet.
definition_of_done: Every contract family has versioned schema, fixtures, producer, consumer, and compatibility evidence.
Ownership remains explicit.
programs.next_packet: Resolve from current contracts and runtime-placement lanes.

programs.title: Cross-project synergy and knowledge promotion
programs.authority: owner truth plus reviewed Playbook promotion contracts
programs.scope: Promote reusable patterns, rules, failure modes, decisions, and synergies without overwriting owner truth or exposing protected data.
serialization: Review precedes promotion.
Canonical owner truth wins conflicts.
definition_of_done: Every promoted item retains source, digest, owner, review, and supersession data.
No owner status is inferred from cross-project similarity.
programs.next_packet: Playbook-first corpus and promotion coverage contract.

programs.title: Model, effort, and speed routing
programs.authority: workflow profile, capability checks, task receipts, and provider policy
programs.scope: Route model, reasoning effort, and speed by task while preserving configured floors, requested/effective receipts, provider boundaries, and explicit fallback.
serialization: Capability-check the actual runtime before selection.
Record requested versus effective settings.
definition_of_done: Every routed task records effective model, effort, speed, provider, and fallback.
No unsupported or silent provider substitution occurs.
programs.next_packet: Capability and receipt coverage audit.

programs.title: Persistent workspace leases
programs.authority: workspace, worker-lease, worktree, queue, and runtime placement contracts
programs.scope: Provide durable, collision-safe workspace leases and restartable worktree ownership without broad cleanup or duplicate writers.
serialization: One writer per claimed workspace.
Lease release or transfer requires a receipt.
definition_of_done: Every active workspace has owner, lease, branch, scope, and restart evidence.
Stale workspaces are classified before cleanup.
programs.next_packet: Resolve from persistent-workspaces and worktree-hygiene lanes.

programs.title: Historical conversation and task knowledge extraction
programs.authority: versioned Atlas memory, provenance manifests, reviewed promotions, and privacy policy
programs.scope: Extract historical ChatGPT conversations and Codex tasks into durable, queryable, provenance-preserving knowledge for Atlas, Playbook, and Cortex.
serialization: Immutable import precedes normalization.
Review precedes promotion or training use.
definition_of_done: Every extracted item has source, digest, trust class, privacy class, and promotion state.
Canonical owner truth remains higher authority than conversation prose.
programs.next_packet: Authorized export and corpus coverage contract.

programs.title: DeepSeek sidecar evaluation
programs.authority: docs/registry/DEEPSEEK-BRIDGE-WAVE-0-ADMISSION.json
programs.scope: Treat the imported proposal as untrusted input; later verify current Codex custom-provider support and evaluate a localhost LiteLLM sidecar with health, exposure, rollback, native fallback, and provider policy. Never treat it as an unproven global replacement.
serialization: Read-only capability verification precedes any runtime design.
This lane remains independent of the FawxzzyPlatform critical path unless evidence proves a dependency.
definition_of_done: Custom-provider support is verified against the current installed Codex runtime.
Any later sidecar has accepted health, loopback exposure, data policy, fallback, rollback, and owner placement evidence.
programs.next_packet: DS-BRIDGE-CAP-001

provenance_guards.historical_values_rule: Historical percentages, denominators, accepted opening/closing contracts, and timestamped evidence remain immutable provenance.

metadata.validation_posture.opening_vali.label: dated July 12 pre-package opening observation; not current health

provenance_guards.guard_basis: Only immutable dated artifacts and immutable historical fields are validated. Mutable lane, marker, initiative, admission, and runtime authority may ratchet without rebasing a full-object digest.

wave_0_admission_baseline.role: Dated no-mutation evidence only; never a current-status guard or competing authority.

provenance_guards.deepseek_historical_marker_rule: The prior 33.3 percent / 2-of-6 initiative snapshot is preserved unchanged as dated provenance; the new Wave 0 evaluation lane is distinct and UNMEASURED.

deepseek_historical_snapshot.marker_movement: Only this lane moved from 16.7% to 33.3%; no other marker moved.

clean_and_resync_lane_registry.status_rule: Resolve status, percentages, denominators, timestamps, and evidence from the authority_ref; this master register does not restate or replace them.

mandatory_closing_audit.current_status_rule: Resolve the current closing-audit status from the authority references; this index does not restate mutable gate status.
mandatory_closing_audit.completion_rule: No discovered lane contributes a point; only a separately accepted exhaustive closing audit can complete gate 2 of 2.
